fusions.name: Host to Host
fusions.desc: A snap that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles, each hit dealing 50% of the original damage. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Clear to the Throat
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles onto the target, then bite for 16 damage and leave it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Over Their Heads
fusions.desc: Leaps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away, with +10% dodge chance. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Next Host
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you leap your bite on to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, which deals 6 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
